pages.text: The Henhouse catches drops from live chickens wandering nearby.

pages.title: Fuel
pages.text: Nearby chicken drops land in a 3x3 output inventory. The Henhouse runs on $(l)FE$() or on $(l)hay$(); burning hay can also produce dirt as a byproduct.$(br2)Six wood variants exist so the block fits whatever barn you are building: oak, spruce, birch, jungle, acacia and dark oak.
